$comment: 听力训练营 L16（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，相似话题干扰：五段都是俱乐部，分别讲在做什么/哪天见面/花多少钱/选哪个/外出活动）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空：姓名拼读 F-O-S-T-E-R、时间、房间号、价格、地名拼读 K-I-N-G-S-L-E-Y）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: Club News
intro: 五段都在说学校俱乐部，但重点不同：在排什么节目、改到哪天、要交多少钱、选哪个、周末去哪儿。再听一段新音乐社的通知，人名和演出场地都要拼出来。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: I'm in the theatre club this year. This term we're doing a play about a lost dog, and I'm the dog's owner.
We practise our songs every week, and the play is in December. My whole family is coming to watch.

questions.q: What is the girl talking about?
options: what her club is doing this term
questions.explain: doing a play about a lost dog / practise our songs / the play is in December——在讲社团这学期在做什么。every week 只是顺带一提，钱没说。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Anna, is chess club still on Monday? I've got football that day now.
No, it's moved to Wednesday, because Mr Hill teaches on Mondays now.
Wednesday is perfect. Same room?
Yes, the same room, after school as always.

questions.q: What are Ben and Anna talking about?
options: the day the chess club meets
the room the chess club uses
questions.explain: still on Monday? / moved to Wednesday / Wednesday is perfect——在说改到哪天。房间没变（same room），比赛没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: A message for everyone in cooking club. From next week, please bring two pounds each time, to pay for the food we use.
It was free before, but food is more expensive now. If two pounds is a problem, come and talk to me.

questions.q: What is the man talking about?
options: the cost of the cooking club
what the club will cook next week
questions.explain: bring two pounds each time / it was free before / more expensive——在说要交钱。做什么菜、谁来教都没说。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Tom, which club are you joining? I can't choose between art and swimming.
Swimming is on Tuesday, and we've got music then. So I'm doing art.
Oh, I forgot about music. Art it is, then.
Great, we can sit together. It's in the room next to the library.

questions.q: What are Jack and Tom talking about?
questions.explain: which club are you joining / can't choose between art and swimming / art it is——在选社团。游泳和音乐只是选择的理由。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Photo club, listen. On Saturday we're going to the park to take pictures of the birds and the lake.
Meet at the school gate at ten with your camera. Wear warm clothes, we'll be outside for two hours.

questions.q: What is the teacher telling the photo club?
questions.explain: going to the park to take pictures / meet at the school gate at ten——在说周六的外出活动。没有比赛，也不是买相机。

sections.intro: 听一段新社团的通知，把笔记补全。老师的名字和演出的地方会拼出来。

script.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Mr Foster, that's F-O-S-T-E-R, and I'm starting a new music club this term.
The club is every Thursday. School finishes at half past three, and we start at quarter to four, so you have time for a drink first.
We meet in room fourteen, the big music room. Not room four, that's too small for all the instruments.
The club costs fifteen pounds for the whole term. Last year it was twenty, but the school is paying for the new guitars.
Our first concert is in March, at Kingsley Hall in the town. That's K-I-N-G-S-L-E-Y. It has room for many more people than the school hall.
If you want to join, write your name on the list outside the music room by Friday. See you on Thursday!

questions.explain: I'm Mr Foster, that's F-O-S-T-E-R，照拼读写。
we start at quarter to four = 3:45。half past three 是放学时间。
we meet in room fourteen = 14。room four 被 not 否定。
fifteen pounds for the whole term = 15。twenty 是去年的价格。
at Kingsley Hall … That's K-I-N-G-S-L-E-Y。不是 school hall。
